name: Sagami Takuto
source:
An ordinary guy whose father is a legendary producer and and whose mother is a singer. At the behest of his older sister, who succeeded his late parents and ran the Sagami Music Office, he stands up as a music producer to turn the company upside down.

[Machine translation from Getchu]
